changes.title: ICE plans to give officers gloves that can deliver electric shocks
changes.summary: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers may soon be outfitted with gloves that can deliver painful electric shocks that are intended to gain compliance from combative individuals.

changes.title: AP report: ICE plans to give its officers gloves that can deliver painful electric shocks
changes.summary: Immigration and Customs Enforcement plans to spend up to $20 million to purchase thousands of gloves that can deliver painful electric shocks intended to gain compliance from individuals.

changes.title: Substance in work van of man killed by ICE tested negative for drugs, prosecutor says
changes.summary: A substance found in the work van of a Mexican immigrant killed by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent has tested negative for illicit drugs, the top prosecutor in Houston said Friday.

changes.title: Video appears to show United employee threatening to call ICE on customer
changes.summary: A United Airlines employee appears to have been caught on video threatening to call U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement on a passenger last week at San Francisco International Airport.

changes.title: Senators demand ICE answers and body cameras after deadly shootings in Maine and Houston
changes.summary: Dozens of Democratic U.S. senators and Maine's Independent senator are demanding more details from Immigration and Customs Enforcement about vetting practices for new agents.

changes.title: ICE officer in Maine shooting has history of violent behavior, relatives say
changes.summary: The Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer who shot and killed a Colombian man in Maine this week is an Army veteran who has struggled with serious mental health issues since early childhood, relatives say.

changes.title: Maine shooting and officer's background raise new questions about ICE's rapid hiring
changes.summary: Immigration and Customs Enforcement has been rapidly expanding its workforce, hiring thousands of new officers as part of the Trump administration's attempt to ramp up immigration arrests and deportations.
